'''Jeg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[A'Mar]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] settlers of [[Lamus]]. He was not eligible to participate in [[the Vigil]] as he had already drank the [[Water/Legends|waters]] from the [[Wellspring (Lamus)|Wellspring]]. He took part in the [[Beastlord's Hunt]] when he was attacked by a [[Brachian Beastlord]] and was [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]]. The group went to the Wellspring to seek help from the offworlders protecting it at that time.
